senses.definition: the time period between dawn and noon
senses.example: I spent the morning running errands

senses.definition: a conventional expression of greeting or farewell
the first light of day
senses.example: we got up before dawn

senses.definition: the earliest period
senses.example: the dawn of civilization

senses.definition: a passenger train that is ridden primarily by passengers who travel regularly from one place to another
someone who travels regularly from home in a suburb to work in a city
public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive
senses.example: express trains don't stop at Princeton Junction

senses.definition: a sequentially ordered set of things or events or ideas in which each successive member is related to the preceding
senses.example: a string of islands

senses.definition: a procession (of wagons or mules or camels) traveling together in single file
senses.example: we were part of a caravan of almost a thousand camels

senses.definition: a series of consequences wrought by an event
senses.example: it led to a train of disasters

senses.definition: piece of cloth forming the long back section of a gown that is drawn along the floor
senses.example: the bride's train was carried by her two young nephews

senses.definition: wheelwork consisting of a connected set of rotating gears by which force is transmitted or motion or torque is changed
senses.example: the fool got his tie caught in the geartrain

senses.definition: create by training and teaching
senses.example: The old master is training world-class violinists

senses.definition: undergo training or instruction in preparation for a particular role, function, or profession
senses.example: She is training to be a teacher

senses.definition: develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control
senses.example: Parents must discipline their children

senses.definition: educate for a future role or function
senses.example: He is grooming his son to become his successor

senses.definition: teach or refine to be discriminative in taste or judgment
senses.example: Cultivate your musical taste

senses.definition: point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
senses.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

senses.definition: teach and supervise (someone); act as a trainer or coach (to), as in sports
senses.example: He is training our Olympic team

senses.definition: exercise in order to prepare for an event or competition
senses.example: She is training for the Olympics

senses.definition: cause to grow in a certain way by tying and pruning it
senses.example: train the vine

senses.definition: travel by rail or train
senses.example: They railed from Rome to Venice

senses.definition: drag loosely along a surface; allow to sweep the ground
senses.example: The toddler was trailing his pants
